_about: Presets of utils/prodwizard.py: the productions and the machines, with the launch settings and rates measured on them. mem_peak_gb: the machine-wide peak measured at that setting (idle included); without it the plan uses vmhwm_gb (a job's measured peak resident memory, max over jobs) per job + 6 GB on a workstation and mem_gb_per_job, the conservative figure for SLURM requests (VmHWM + page cache); a SLURM --mem is computed from it unless the machine's setting gives mem_gb (a fixed node share). Rates are events/h for the whole machine (per GPU for slurm machines), [low, high]. 'measured' says whether the rate was measured with the current image at this setting; every number names its source. Update these when a new benchmark is made.
